requirements.title: Account opening
requirements.text: A customer can open an account by giving their full name, an initial deposit and a 6-digit PIN.
acceptance_criteria: A blank or whitespace-only name is rejected.
A negative initial deposit is rejected. An initial deposit of SGD 0.00 is allowed.
A newly opened account has status ACTIVE and a balance equal to the initial deposit.

requirements.title: Account number format
requirements.text: Each account gets an account number made of the prefix "SG" and 8 digits, e.g. SG01234567.
acceptance_criteria: Account numbers match the pattern SG\d{8}.
No two accounts share an account number.

requirements.title: Deposits
requirements.text: A customer can deposit money into an active account.
acceptance_criteria: The deposit amount must be greater than zero; zero or negative amounts are rejected.
The balance increases by exactly the deposited amount.

requirements.title: Withdrawals and insufficient funds
requirements.text: A customer can withdraw money from an active account, but never more than the available balance. Overdrafts are not offered.
acceptance_criteria: A withdrawal larger than the balance is rejected with an insufficient-funds error.
After a rejected withdrawal, the balance is unchanged.

requirements.title: Account closure
requirements.text: An account can be closed only when its balance is exactly SGD 0.00.
acceptance_criteria: Closing an account with a non-zero balance is rejected, and the account stays ACTIVE.
Closing an account with a zero balance sets its status to CLOSED.

requirements.title: Frozen accounts
requirements.text: An account in status FROZEN cannot receive deposits or make withdrawals.
acceptance_criteria: A deposit to a frozen account is rejected.
A withdrawal from a frozen account is rejected.
The balance of a frozen account is not changed by rejected operations.

requirements.title: PIN lockout
requirements.text: To prevent brute-force attacks, an account is automatically frozen after 3 consecutive failed PIN verification attempts.
acceptance_criteria: After the third consecutive incorrect PIN, the account status becomes FROZEN.
A successful verification resets the failed-attempt counter to zero.
Two failures, then a success, then two more failures leaves the account ACTIVE.

requirements.title: Balance enquiry
requirements.text: A balance enquiry returns the account balance rounded to two decimal places (half-up).
acceptance_criteria: An account holding 10.005 reports a balance of 10.01.

requirements.title: Atomic funds transfer
requirements.text: A transfer debits the source account and credits the destination account as one atomic operation.
acceptance_criteria: After a completed transfer of X, the source balance is lower by X and the destination balance is higher by X.
If the credit cannot be applied (e.g. destination not active), the source balance is unchanged.

requirements.title: No self-transfers
requirements.text: A transfer where source and destination are the same account is rejected.
acceptance_criteria: Transferring from an account to itself raises a validation error.

requirements.title: Daily transfer limit
requirements.text: The total of outgoing transfers from one account in a calendar day must not exceed SGD 5,000.00. The limit is inclusive: a day's total of exactly SGD 5,000.00 is allowed.
acceptance_criteria: Given SGD 4,000.00 already transferred today (to an existing payee), a further transfer of SGD 1,000.00 is accepted.
After that, a transfer of SGD 0.01 is rejected with a daily-limit error.
Transfers made on a previous calendar day do not count towards today's limit.

requirements.title: New payee review
requirements.text: A transfer of more than SGD 1,000.00 to a new payee is held for manual fraud review and not executed immediately.
acceptance_criteria: A first-time transfer of SGD 1,000.01 or more to a payee has status PENDING_REVIEW, and neither balance changes.
A first-time transfer of exactly SGD 1,000.00 completes immediately.
Once one transfer to a payee has completed, later transfers to that payee are not held.

requirements.title: Transfer reference
requirements.text: Every transfer gets a unique reference of the form "TRF-" followed by 8 upper-case alphanumeric characters, plus a timestamp.
acceptance_criteria: References match TRF-[A-Z0-9]{8} and are unique.
Each transfer records the time it was created.

requirements.title: Transfer history
requirements.text: A customer can view the transfer history of an account, including both incoming and outgoing transfers, most recent first.
acceptance_criteria: History includes transfers where the account is the source or the destination.
Transfers are listed newest first.
Transfers between two other accounts do not appear.

requirements.title: Scheduled transfers
requirements.text: A customer can schedule a transfer for a future date. The transfer runs automatically on that date and can be cancelled before then.
acceptance_criteria: A scheduled transfer does not move funds before its execution date.
On the execution date, the transfer is executed under the same rules as REQ-TRF-01 to REQ-TRF-04.
A cancelled scheduled transfer is never executed.

requirements.title: Loan amount bounds
requirements.text: Personal loans can be requested for SGD 1,000.00 to SGD 100,000.00 inclusive.
acceptance_criteria: 999.99 and 100,000.01 are rejected; 1,000.00 and 100,000.00 are eligible.

requirements.title: Loan tenure
requirements.text: The loan tenure is 12 to 60 months inclusive.
acceptance_criteria: 11 and 61 months are rejected; 12 and 60 months are eligible.

requirements.title: Monthly instalment calculation
requirements.text: The monthly instalment uses the standard amortisation formula M = P*r*(1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1), where r is the annual rate / 12 and n is the tenure in months. The result is rounded to the nearest cent (half-up).
acceptance_criteria: SGD 25,000.00 at 5.5% p.a. over 36 months -> instalment SGD 754.90.
SGD 60,000.00 at 4.5% p.a. over 48 months -> instalment SGD 1,368.21.

requirements.title: Affordability check
requirements.text: An application is rejected when the applicant's monthly income is less than 3 times the monthly instalment.
acceptance_criteria: Income below 3x the instalment -> REJECTED with an affordability reason.
Income of 3x the instalment or more -> eligible.

requirements.title: Interest rate tiers
requirements.text: Interest rate depends on the loan amount tier.
acceptance_criteria: SGD 20,000.00 to SGD 50,000.00 inclusive -> 5.5%.

requirements.title: Early repayment fee
requirements.text: A borrower who repays early pays a fee of 1.5% of the outstanding principal, rounded to the nearest cent (half-up).
acceptance_criteria: Outstanding principal SGD 12,345.67 -> fee SGD 185.19.
Outstanding principal SGD 10,000.00 -> fee SGD 150.00.

requirements.title: Loan decision
requirements.text: Every loan application gets a decision of APPROVED or REJECTED. Rejected applications carry a human-readable reason.
acceptance_criteria: Approved loans have no rejection reason; rejected loans always have one.
A decided application can be retrieved by its identifier.
